brief:
**BLUF:** A woman died in a house fire Friday evening on Peery Addition Road in Tazewell County; Virginia State Police are investigating. Grants Supermarket in Richlands closed after its final day of business Saturday, citing average monthly electric bills of $25,000 from the town utility. The Pocahontas Pumpkin Festival on Saturday raised funds for the Pocy Paws spay/neuter program. No active NWS alerts or major regional incidents reported in the last 24 hours.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/10/tazewell-co-house-fire-leaves-one-woman-dead/)[[2]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/10/why-is-a-richlands-grocery-store-closing-high-town-electric-rates-that-average-25000-per-month-the-owners-say/)[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/10/pocahontas-pumpkin-festival-raises-funds-pocy-paws-spay-neuter-program/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Tazewell County, Va.** — One woman died in a house fire Friday evening in the area of Peery Addition Road. Tazewell County 911 confirmed the fatality; the victim has not been publicly identified. Virginia State Police are investigating the cause.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/10/tazewell-co-house-fire-leaves-one-woman-dead/)

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Richlands, Tazewell County, Va.** — Grants Supermarket, a 25-year staple serving Richlands and surrounding areas, closed at the end of business Saturday. Owners cited high town electric utility rates averaging $25,000 per month over the past two years, plus the approaching lease end, as the reason for not renewing.[[2]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/10/why-is-a-richlands-grocery-store-closing-high-town-electric-rates-that-average-25000-per-month-the-owners-say/)

**Pocahontas, Tazewell County, Va.** — The rescheduled Pocahontas Pumpkin Festival at Town Hall on Saturday featured vendors, food, and fundraising for the Pocy Paws spay/neuter program to address stray cats and support local pet owners and the Tazewell County Animal Shelter.[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/10/pocahontas-pumpkin-festival-raises-funds-pocy-paws-spay-neuter-program/)

**Southwest Virginia (region)** — A Cardinal News report highlighted the shrinking rural maternity care landscape and the expanding role of midwives in the area.[[4]](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/939406788/the-best-fall-festivals-events-in-pocahontas-county)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
Nothing scheduled or developing reported in available sources.
